scenes.title: Утренние игры  (Morning Games)
scenes.summary: Max playfully calls himself a horny Spider-Man, but Vika tells him to take a shower first.

scenes.title: Жажда веселья  (Thirst for Fun)
scenes.summary: Someone proposes to have some fun, and another eagerly agrees.

scenes.title: Серьёзный парень  (A Serious Guy)
scenes.summary: Eleonora criticizes Vika's choice of Max. Later, Dmitry orders Viktor to cater an outdoor banquet for an oil tycoon's wife.

scenes.title: Лицо ресторана  (Face of the Restaurant)
scenes.summary: Dmitry calls Viktor, who is arriving late and intoxicated to the catering event.

scenes.title: Пьяный шеф  (The Drunk Chef)
scenes.summary: Victoria intercepts a heavily intoxicated Chef Barinov in the corridor.

scenes.title: Нервы су-шефа  (The Sous-Chef's Nerves)
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, a nervous Leva panics at the thought of temporarily replacing the drunk Chef Barinov. His friend Senya gives him an encouraging pep talk.

scenes.title: Байки Макса  (Max's Tall Tales)
scenes.summary: Max shows off in front of the dining room girls, pretending to be a famous chef who cooked for Gerard Depardieu in Paris.

scenes.title: Обещание Нагиева  (Nagiyev's Promise)
scenes.summary: Restaurant owner Dmitry Nagiyev greets VIP guest Diana, who excitedly praises the handsome and sociable head chef she just met, unknowingly talking about Max.

scenes.title: Французские блюда  (French Dishes)
scenes.summary: In the kitchen of Claude Monet, Max finishes preparing the gourmet French dishes at the pass and instructs Kostya to deliver the plates to the VIP table immediately.

scenes.title: Заказ для гостей  (Order for the Guests)
scenes.summary: Kostya delivers the exquisite French meals to the VIP table in the dining room, where the guests express their delight and thank the kitchen for the wonderful dinner.

scenes.title: Разбитое сердце  (Broken Heart)
scenes.summary: An upset woman guest corners Max in the dining room and angrily confronts him for breaking her heart, demanding that he delete her phone number and leave her alone.

scenes.title: Слёзы на кухне  (Tears in the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Pastry chef Louis weeps in the kitchen over personal heartbreak until Chef Viktor strictly orders him to stop crying and finish the desserts, before yelling at the rest of the crew to get to work.

scenes.title: Где шеф?  (Where is the Chef?)
scenes.summary: They are looking for Max to prepare a French masterpiece.

scenes.title: Сим-карта в десерте  (SIM Card in Dessert)
scenes.summary: Lyova refuses to deal with a customer who found a SIM card.

scenes.title: Знакомство с шефом  (Meeting the Chef)
scenes.summary: A guest introduces Max to everyone as a French chef.

scenes.title: Идиот  (Idiot)
scenes.summary: Louis mocks Max for confusing French and Italian.

scenes.title: Защитник Лёва  (Defender Leva)
scenes.summary: In the dining room, an angry guest complains to the pastry chef Louis about finding something hard in his dessert. Louis is terrified. Leva bravely steps in, claims to be the head chef, and takes responsibility.

scenes.title: Режим терминатора  (Terminator Mode)
scenes.summary: Back in the kitchen, Leva tries to assert his new authority as the temporary head chef. He orders the cooks to work faster. Senya and Fedya support him and joke about switching to Terminator mode.

scenes.title: План Макса  (Max's Plan)
scenes.summary: In a brief moment of chaos, Max realizes he needs to take control of a difficult situation. He tells his colleagues that they will figure it out and urges them to go.

scenes.title: Сосед из Парижа  (A Neighbor from Paris)
scenes.summary: Chef Victor wants to impress someone with his French friend Jacques. Jacques mumbles in French and tries to kiss Victor. Victor stops him and offers him some food first.

scenes.title: Дегустатор  (The Taster)
scenes.summary: While the drunk French chef Jacques and his guests sing La Marseillaise, restaurant owner Dmitry Nagiyev steps up to taste the dish prepared by Max in the kitchen.

scenes.title: Божественно  (Divine)
scenes.summary: Dmitry Nagiyev tastes the dish and declares it divine, praising his own luck and the skill of the kitchen staff to the applause of the guests.

scenes.title: Максим молодец  (Maxim Did Great)
scenes.summary: Watching from the bar, Nastya and Kostya discuss how well Max handled the crisis, noting that Victoria must feel terrible for insulting him earlier.

scenes.title: Храбрый круассан  (The Brave Croissant)
scenes.summary: Max approaches Victoria at the bar, and they playfully flirt using culinary terms, ending with Victoria thanking him for saving the evening.

scenes.title: Настоящий шеф  (A Real Head Chef)
scenes.summary: In his office, a furious Dmitry Nagiyev reprimands Chef Barinov for getting drunk on the job, then Barinov privately thanks Lyova for stepping up and taking responsibility like a true head chef.

scenes.title: Выводы  (Conclusions)
scenes.summary: Max reflects on the strange nature of responsibility, while Chef Barinov proudly announces he will no longer drink at work—and immediately suggests celebrating this decision with a drink.
